Italian Roast Beef
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 15, 2009 - 2:07pm

Ingredients




4 pounds beef roast
2 onions
2 garlic cloves
1 celery stalk
2 ounces bacon
Flour as needed
Seasonings to taste

Preparation

1 Process into a paste one of the onions, garlic, celery, and bacon. Flour the roast. Rub roast with the paste. 2 Slice other onion; place in bottom of pot. Set roast on the onion. Cover and cook (crock pot) on LOW for 10 to 12 hours.
